title: One-Pan Parmesan Spinach Orzo
description: Orzo cooks directly in its Parmesan sauce with ribbons of spinach.

steps.title: Set the heat
steps.text: Use the lidded HexClad wok on a medium burner.

steps.title: Build flavor
steps.text: Toast {pasta} in {butter} for 2 minutes until golden at the edges.

steps.title: Cook gently
steps.text: Pour in {broth}; simmer 10–13 minutes, stirring often, until pasta is tender and broth clings.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fold in {spin} until wilted. Remove from heat and stir in {parm}.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers and refrigerate up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze up to 1 month; grains and vegetables soften slightly. Fridge reheat: stir with a spoonful of water over low heat until 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge and warm by the same method. Dairy swap: use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese as applicable. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 267 kcal, 11.3 g protein, 39.7 g total carbohydrate, 6.7 g fat, 2.1 g fiber, 224 mg sodium.
